prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / VFX sprite production. Create an original transparent PNG of SEPARATE COMBAT VFX for the four approved enemies in image1, stylistically matched to previous pixel sprites image2. Not concept art; no characters/weapon items, HUD, text, numbers, labels, grids or shadows.
Exactly28 distinct animated drawings, arranged SEVEN evenly spaced rows x FOUR columns, invisible grid, preferred1024x1792. Every cell one complete independent effect, generous empty transparent gutter, no clipping or overlap, TRUE alpha background. Crisp limited-color pixel clusters, stepped edges and restrained highlights, no smooth blurred vector crescents or fog. Same elevated orthographic overworld perspective; ground impacts are FLATTENED horizontal ellipses, not vertical circles. Four columns show purposeful progressions in each row, not translated copies.
ROW1 shadow_contact: compact dark-purple/violet crossed TWO-blade slash, anticipation tiny shard, crossing contact, broken violet arcs, fading dark shards. Purple-white highlights and black core; short, readable.
ROW2 general_contact: broad black/silver/crimson halberd slash + 3 gold metallic sparks, initial narrow arc, strongest broad sweep, short low ground contact with angular grey chips, faded spark fragments. No weapon or body.
ROW3 blood_contact: dark crimson geometric magic SIGIL impact, compact diamond/rune formation, expanded four-point sigil with red-white center, broken dark-crimson angular rune shards, fading small red shards. NO orange/yellow fire, gore, liquid blood or flame shapes.
ROW4 vanguard_contact: compact red/dark-gold heavy-weapon shockwave, narrow ground fissure mark, strongest low flattened elliptical red force arc + grey chips, broken low red arc, fading demonic red shards. This is contact presentation only, no large boss arena ring.
ROW5 blood_projectile: FOUR loop phases of one compact blood-red crystal/rune orb traveling SCREEN-RIGHT, dark crimson core, small angular red-white highlights, trailing short black/crimson flecks to LEFT. Same size and center across loop; no flame or orange. Separate projectile, not body-attached.
ROW6 shadow_trail: FOUR loop phases of low close-fitting purple/black wisps and tiny violet ghost fragments, trailing to LEFT, faint compressed afterimage-like shapes but NO full character or weapon. Compact footprint.
ROW7 vanguard_aura: FOUR loop phases of low horizontal ominous crimson/dark-red wisp arc, few dark-gold motes at edges, hugging a future actor's feet but draw NO actor; compact translucent-looking effect rendered with deliberate pixel clusters.
Only these28 effects; no extra swatches/callouts. Maintain exact purple shadow vs black/metal sparks vs dark crimson rune magic vs heavy red impact identities. Frames must be usable as independent animation cels.
